name: Man-Eater🌟
description:
Charges forcibly dash to Charybdis, briefly liquefying terrain. Jabs near the whirlpool pull in enemies and execute at 10% HP, sating 1 hunger.

A mythical enchant discovered on the relic [orange]Scylla[/orange].

[dark-green]Messina[/dark-green] is a trident, [blue]Charybdis[/blue], whose throws leave [orange]Scylla[/orange] in your hand.
